title: E. Vlad and an Odd Ordering
statement:
Vladislav has n cards numbered 1, 2, …, n. He wants to lay them down in a row as follows:

The first line contains an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 5·10^4) — the number of test cases.

The only line of each test case contains two integers n and k (1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 10^9) — the number of cards Vlad has, and the position of the card you need to output.

For each test case, output a single integer — the k-th card Vladislav lays down.

In the first seven test cases, n=7. Vladislav lays down the cards as follows:

Input:
```
117 17 27 37 47 57 67 71 134 1484 191000000000 1000000000
```

Output:
```
1
3
5
7
2
6
4
1
27
37
536870912
```
